Package com.sca4d.gateway.registration

Class GatewayRegistrationController

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.gateway.registration.GatewayRegistrationController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/internal/gateway/registrations") public final class GatewayRegistrationController extends Object
提供 Server 实例注册、续租和带租约 ID 保护的注销控制 API。
